look_here_first: Start with the deciduous feathery branchlets and buttressed wet-site trunk. Baldcypress is a large deciduous conifer with flat two-ranked leaves on many lateral shoots, fibrous reddish-brown bark, round woody cones, and often knees or a swollen fluted base near water.

key_traits.text: feathery two-ranked leaves on many lateral shoots

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: foliage turns coppery and sheds in winter

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: swollen/fluted trunk base in wet sites

lookalikes.differences: Deciduous conifer + feathery two-ranked foliage + wet-site buttressed trunk/knees + round cones is the core field package.
